provenance.note: Unmodified public read results; historical snapshots are not current financial claims. No simulation, signing or sends.

candles.query: query CapturedCandles($pool: String!) { Candle(where: {pool: {_eq: $pool}, intervalSeconds: {_eq: 3600}}, order_by: [{bucketStart: desc}], limit: 300) { bucketStart intervalSeconds openPrice high low closePrice baseVolume } }

history.query: query CapturedHistory($account: String!) { Fill(where: {_or: [{taker: {_eq: $account}}, {maker: {_eq: $account}}]}, order_by: [{timestamp: asc}], limit: 100) {id txHash blockNumber timestamp pool fillPrice quantity taker maker takerIsBid} }
